summary.zh: 设计面试轮次、能力矩阵、评分表与题库
summary.en: Design hiring loops, competency matrices, rubrics and question banks.

description.zh: 按岗位拆解能力项，排出面试轮次与每轮的考察重点，配好评分表和题库，还能检查面试官打分是否一致。适合新开岗位、重做招聘流程或复盘面试质量时使用。
description.en: Breaks a role into competencies, lays out interview rounds with what each probes, and supplies rubrics and question banks. It also checks whether interviewers score consistently. Use it for a new role or a hiring rebuild.
